title: What brass bands lack: alto and baritone fill
summary: Barbarin says modern brass bands lack alto, baritone and E-flat clarinet parts, and praises John Porter's reading.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists
